title: 2024 Topps Chrome Update Series - X-Fractor Refractor Brett Harris #USC183 (RC)
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Topps Chrome Update Series trading card features Brett Harris of the Oakland Athletics. The card is a rookie X-Fractor Refractor parallel with a card number of USC183. It is an original Topps manufacture and is part of the Major League Baseball (MLB) set. The card is in standard size and is in English language. 

The card is not autographed and is not a vintage or licensed reprint. It was manufactured in the United States in 2024 and is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection. This sports trading card is a must-have for fans of the Oakland Athletics or Brett Harris.
